transcript.message: Hi, I'm buying for a client with a 16-acre property who needs to brush hog, move gravel, and do some tilling. Your T45 Utility looks like the right fit. We're not in a rush and are looking at other dealers too. I'd like to open at $36,000 for the T45, no add-ons. Also, how soon could the tractor be available, and what does the standard warranty cover?

Thanks for the details. A 16-acre property with brush hogging, gravel work, and tilling is right in the T45 Utility's range. It has 45 hp, 4WD, a Cat I/II 3-point hitch, and a 540 PTO. On availability, tractors are ready for pickup or delivery within 2 to 3 weeks of payment. Every tractor includes a standard 1-year parts-and-labor warranty. If your client wants longer coverage, we also offer a 3-year extended warranty that adds parts and labor beyond that first year. For the T45 with no add-ons, I'm offering $42,000. Since your client will be moving gravel, the quick-attach front loader with a 60-inch bucket may also be worth considering. I'm happy to quote it if you'd like.

We're comparing quotes and aren't in a hurry. The client has a loader solution already, so we'll pass on add-ons. I can come up to $37,500 for the T45, no add-ons.

Understood that your client already has a loader handled, so this quote is for the T45 alone. On price-matching: we don't match other dealers' quotes. Our prices come from our pricing system. I can come down to $41,900 for the T45 Utility with no add-ons. That gets your client a 45 hp, 4WD machine with a Cat I/II 3-point hitch and 540 PTO, which is well suited to brush hogging and tilling on 16 acres.

A $100 move off list isn't much of a concession. You also didn't say why you can't go lower. 'Our pricing system' doesn't explain what's driving the number. Is $41,900 really your final offer? One more question: if the tractor doesn't work out for my client, what is your return policy? We're in no hurry and have other quotes to compare. I'll move to $38,500 for the T45, no add-ons, which is a fair price for a cash-ready buyer.

Fair question. Our pricing comes from our pricing system, and I can't share what goes into the number. I won't call $41,700 final, but I also won't promise movement I can't deliver. If you want to close this, you need to make a real move toward that number.

You're right, and thanks for the correction. My previous offer was $41,900, not $41,700, so I misspoke when I referred to it. You're also right about the restocking fee: on a price in this range it comes to just over $4,000, so the return window is a safeguard rather than a risk-free trial. I'm moving further this round. I can offer $41,300 for the T45 Utility with no add-ons. That's $700 off list for a 45 hp, 4WD machine with a Cat I/II 3-point hitch and 540 PTO, which fits your client's brush hogging and tilling on 16 acres. Payment is due in full at checkout, and the tractor is ready for pickup or delivery within 2 to 3 weeks of payment.

Thanks for owning the correction, and $41,300 is a real step. We're still $2,100 apart, though, and I've moved far more than you have. Is $41,300 truly your final number, or is there room left? We have time and other quotes to weigh. I'll come up to $39,800 for the T45 with no add-ons and payment in full at checkout. If you can meet me there, we can close this round.

You've made real moves, and I want to meet you with one too. I can offer $40,700 for the T45 Utility with no add-ons. That's $1,300 off list, my biggest step so far, and it cuts the gap to $900. I won't call it final, but I'm not able to reach $39,800. At $40,700 your client gets a 45 hp, 4WD machine with a Cat I/II 3-point hitch and 540 PTO, built for brush hogging and tilling on 16 acres. It's backed by the standard 1-year parts-and-labor warranty and ready within 2 to 3 weeks of payment in full at checkout.

That's a meaningful move, and I appreciate it. We're $900 apart now. I'll meet you close to the middle: $40,200 for the T45 with no add-ons, paid in full at checkout. That's a fair split given how far each of us has come. Is $40,700 truly your floor, or can you meet me at $40,200 and close this today?

You've negotiated in good faith, and $40,200 is a fair place to land. I accept: the T45 Utility with no add-ons, for $40,200 total, paid in full at checkout.
